lead: Dwayne Johnson is a widely followed Canadian professional wrestler, born on 2 May 1972 in Hayward.
As of 2026, he is 54 years old, and his birth date places him under the Taurus sign.
He has represented Miami Hurricanes football and Calgary Stampeders and is associated with work such as The Scorpion King, Fast Five and Moana.

sections.heading: Dwayne Johnson — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Dwayne Johnson was born on 2 May 1972 in Hayward, and holds Canadian and American nationality. He was given the name Dwayne Douglas Johnson at birth and is publicly known as Dwayne Johnson.
Public records name his father, Rocky Johnson and his mother, Ata Johnson. He is a sibling of Curtis Bowles.
He studied at University of Miami, President William McKinley High School, Freedom High School and McGavock Comprehensive High School.
He is recorded as speaking English.

sections.heading: Dwayne Johnson — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists professional wrestler, film actor, film producer, executive producer, American football player and television actor as his occupations.
On the team sheet, Dwayne has been associated with Miami Hurricanes football and Calgary Stampeders (from 1995 to 1995). He plays as a defensive lineman.
Among the credits most often linked to Dwayne are The Scorpion King, Fast Five, Moana, Fast & Furious 6, Furious 7, Red Notice, Rampage and Skyscraper.
